articles.title: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
articles.content: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. We present PixVid, a simple yet effective method that lifts a pretrained latent video model to directly generate every frame in pixel space. PixVid keeps the diffusion transformer and replaces the VAE decoder with a convolutional head that renders its outputs into pixels. We find that predicting clean video rather than velocity, together with a larger noise shift, is key to quality. Finetuned from Wan2.1-14B, PixVid is competitive with the latent baseline within $\sim 1.3$M training clips. Working framewise in pixels, it generates at $2\times$ higher resolution with the same per-frame token count, keeps depth-conditioned video editing aligned under fast motion, and responds to each action at the next frame. Project page: https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/

articles.title_zh: 回像素:将Latent视频扩散到像素空间
articles.content_zh: 边疆视频生成模型在VAE潜在空间中工作,在空间和时间上压缩视频. 这种压缩使得训练可以进行,但现在限制了高分辨率,可控,交互的生成——双倍分辨率四重奏符号计数,条件适用于各种帧而不是单个帧,每个响应必须等待其多帧块的其余部分. 我们提出 PixVid,是一种简单而有效的方法,可以提升一个预先训练过的潜伏视频模型,直接生成像素空间中的每个帧. 像素 Vid保持扩散变压器,并用一个使输出成像素的转录头取代VAE解码器. 我们认为,预测干净的视频而不是速度,加上更大的噪音变化,是质量的关键。 PixVid从Wan2.1-14B的微调中,在1.3M美元培训剪辑中具有潜在基线的竞争力。 工作帧在像素中,以2\times$更高分辨率生成,每帧符号计数相同,保持深度条件视频编辑在快速运动下对齐,并在下一个帧中响应每个动作. 项目网页:https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/

articles.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
articles.content: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 解开多式联运愿景编码
articles.content_zh: 多种语文模式应如何编码视觉投入的问题仍有待讨论。 大多数模型使用预先训练的视觉编码器,而一些近期的食谱则用语言模型从头开始训练编码器或者完全去除. 视觉编码器将三个设计选择组合在一起:上游预训前的视觉、专用视觉能力以及这种能力的预置(即在多式联运主干线之前)。 因为公布的模型在数据,架构,和计算上也有所不同,因此比较它们不能孤立每个选择的效果. 我们通过一个控制框架来解析这些选择, 将所有模型从头到尾地从共同数据中筛选出来, 在视觉问题答案和语言基准上进行比较, 在相应的寿命计算中。 我们认为,视觉前置没有必要;从头开始联合训练的编码器与预先训练的编码相同,没有单独的训练阶段。 而重要的是专用的视觉能力:一个没有编码器的模型跟踪视觉理解,即使它的骨干被编码器的参数计数所扩大. 然而,这种能力不需要在多式联运之前,因为仅将视觉模块添加到早期骨干层中,其性能与核聚变前的编码器相当,并且可以将时间缩短到第一。 这些结果也持有跨骨干大小,当编码器预训作为免费处理时,以及从预训语言模型开始. 总体而言,我们的调查结果倾向于与骨干部门共同培训专门的愿景能力,并尽早将其纳入其中。

articles.title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
articles.content: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) with KV-cache have recently achieved state-of-the-art quality by regressing novel views from neural networks without reconstructing 3D geometry, while Test-Time Training (TTT) layers save computation but sacrifice quality. We propose Test-Time Baking (TTB), a strategy that learns to bake global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, enabling fast and high-fidelity novel-view decoding. The first key is to repurpose the fast-weight MLP of TTT to learn the cross-view attention mapping explicitly from its input-output pairs, rather than replacing attention entirely, achieving the same rendering efficiency as TTT while delivering substantially higher quality. The second key addresses a modality misalignment between context prefilling and novel-view rendering: we disentangle context tokens into camera-only context rendering tokens to serve as TTB input, and context ground-truth tokens with image content to serve as the TTB mapping target, ensuring the baked MLPs are relieved of the modality generalization challenge between context and novel-view processing. Our method achieves up to **23x** rendering speedup with quality on par with the state-of-the-art across several benchmarks. Project page: https://test-time-baking.github.io
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TTB: 高效渲染解码器的测试时间
articles.content_zh: 仅用解码器的大型视图合成模型(LVSM)与KV-cache最近通过在不重建3D几何功能的情况下从神经网络中退缩新观点而实现了最先进的质量,而Test-Time Training(TT)层则节省了计算但牺牲质量. 我们提出Test-Time Baking(TTB),这个策略学习将全球场景信息从交叉视野的注意力烘烤成轻量级的MLP,使得快速和高真实度的小说视野解码成为可能. 第一个关键是重新使用TTT的快重MLP,从输入输出对子中明确学习交叉视图注意力映射,而不是完全取代注意力,实现与TTT相同的渲染效率,同时交付质量大大提高. 第二键处理上下文预填充和小说视图渲染之间的模式错配:我们把上下文符号分解为仅相机上下文渲染符号作为TTB输入,而上下文地面真实符号则使用图像内容作为TTB映射目标,确保烤的MLP解除上下文和小说视图处理之间的模式泛化挑战. 我们的方法可达到**23x** 使速度与若干基准的先进水平相当。 项目网页:https://test-time-baking.github.io

articles.title: ProtoVis-Nav: Prototypical Visual Imagination for Visual-Spatial Aligned UAV Navigation
articles.content: Vision language navigation (VLN) is very challenging for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) since small errors in 3D motion prediction can lead to navigation errors and collisions. Unable to fathom execution outcomes in 3D environments, existing methods often struggle to predict accurate navigation waypoints from language instructions. To solve this, we introduce the Prototypical Visual Imagination framework, shortened as ProtoVis-Nav, which forces the model to imagine an outcome-associated local visual representation for the intended next UAV movement. Specifically, we predict feature prototypes and use their linear combination to estimate the visual feature of the target region. In this manner, the VLN model first imagines the local visual representation of the next intended location, and then uses predicted prototypes as context for generating the final action, promoting alignment between visual context and waypoint outputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the ProtoVis-Nav framework and show substantial improvements over existing baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Proto Vis-Nav:视觉-空间相配无人驾驶飞行器导航的原型视觉想象
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言导航(VLN)对于无人驾驶飞行器(UAVs)来说是非常具有挑战性的,因为3D运动预测中的小错误会导致导航错误和碰撞. 无法在3D环境中fathom执行结果,现有方法往往难以从语言指令中预测准确的导航路标. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了原型视觉想象框架,缩短为ProtoVis-Nav,这个框架迫使模型想象出一个与预期的下一个无人机运动相关的本地视觉表现. 具体来说,我们预测特征原型,并使用它们的线性组合来估计目标区域的视觉特征. 这样,VLN模型首先想象下一个预定位置的当地视觉表现,然后使用预测的原型作为产生最终行动的上下文,促进视觉上下文与路标输出的一致. 广泛的实验表明ProtoVis-Nav框架的有效性,并显示比现有基线有重大改进。

articles.title: K2V: Generative Keyframing For Physically Plausible Video Generation
articles.content: Video diffusion models are able to generate samples with high-quality appearance and textural qualities. However, content produced by these methods is known to exhibit significant physical errors. This is because, in a classical video generation setting, all physical reasoning must take place simultaneously and exclusively within the diffusion process.We propose to resolve these issues by redistributing the task of physical reasoning onto a language model-backed keyframe generation module, which allows for explicit reasoning in language, and fine-grained control over the appearance of the video at important moments in the video. We then condition a video generation model with these keyframes, reducing the role of the diffusion model to the simpler task of interpolating between physically-correct intermediate states, rather than inferring an entire sequence with diffusion. Results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark and PhyGenBench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: K2V : 物理的基因密钥 播放视频生成
articles.content_zh: 视频传播模型能够生成具有高质量外观和纹理品质的样本. 然而,据了解,这些方法产生的内容存在重大的物理错误。 这是因为,在一个古典的视频生成环境中,所有物理推理必须同时进行,并且完全在传播过程中进行. 我们建议通过将物理推理的任务重新分配给一个语言模型支持的键框生成模块来解决这些问题,这个模块允许在语言中明确推理,并在视频的重要时刻精细地控制视频的出现. 然后我们用这些键框来设定一个视频生成模型, 将扩散模型的作用降低到更简单的任务, 在物理正确中间状态之间插插, 而不是用扩散来推断整个序列。 结果表明,我们的做法大大超过现有做法,在物理-IQ验证基准和PhyGen Bench上取得了最新业绩。

articles.title: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
articles.content: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to inject image conditioning, using 1% as much data. However, while the learned flow captures global structure, it does not enforce connectivity. To address this, we introduce an analytic connectivity-field guidance to pull predictions toward connected assemblies at test time. Through this, we demonstrate improved build quality with model size, pretraining, and guidance. We make our models and data available for research purposes at https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 砖花:连接-导线砖重建
articles.content_zh: 鉴于一组LEGO部件和一个集合对象的图像,我们的任务是推断每个部分的姿势来组装对象. 与传统的立体重建不同,这样做需要满足离散的物理制约,这提供了结构,但使问题组合起来,并对小的构成错误高度敏感。 为了了解各部分如何组合在一起的先验情况,我们在程序生成的组件上培训一个固定条件的SE(3)流动模型。 然后我们微调这个模型注入图像调制, 使用1%的数据。 然而,虽然知识流抓住了全球结构,但它并没有强制实施互联互通。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了一个分析连接域指导,在测试时对连接的组件进行预测。 通过这种方式,我们用模型大小、预训和指导来展示建筑质量的提高。 我们在https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/网站上提供我们的模型和数据供研究之用。

articles.title: Spatial Foundry: A Multimodal Dataset for Spatial Intelligence
articles.content: Spatial intelligence requires connecting visual observations to the geometry, objects, and persistent state of an environment. Images alone leave these relationships implicit, while disconnected annotations make it difficult to study appearance, camera motion, and scene changes under a common reference. We introduce Spatial Foundry, a collection of 5,280 furnished residential 3D scene configurations with editable assets and aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data. Its modalities include floor plans, perspective and panoramic RGB, metric depth, point clouds, meshes, instance-level 3D bounding boxes, and camera trajectories paired with video. Shared scene coordinates link observations across views and time; editable source scenes enable additional camera paths and controlled object changes. We describe the data representation and construction workflow, and discuss applications in floor-plan-conditioned 3D generation, geometric reconstruction, instance-level perception, camera-conditioned video generation, shared world modeling, and scene editing. Controlled camera and scene variations support spatial perception and world-model research. The public project page provides videos and an interactive colored point-cloud preview.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 空间创始人:空间情报的多式联运数据集
articles.content_zh: 空间智能要求将视觉观测与几何、物体和环境的持续状态联系起来。 光是图像就让这些关系隐含下来,而断开的注释则使得在共同的参考下很难研究外观,相机运动和场景变化. 我们引入了空间铸币局,它收集了5 280个三维住宅场景配置,配有可编辑资产和对齐的视觉、几何和时间数据。 其模式包括地板图,视角和全景RGB,度量深度,点云,网格,例级3D边框,以及相机轨迹与视频对齐. 共享的场景坐标将跨视图和时间的观测链接起来;可编辑的源场景可以使更多的相机路径和控制对象改变. 我们描述了数据表达和构建工作流程,并讨论了底板规划条件下的3D生成,几何重建,实例层面的感知,相机条件下的视频生成,共享世界模型,以及场景编辑中的应用. 受控相机和场景变化支持空间感知和世界模型研究. 公共项目页面提供视频和交互式的彩色点云预览.

articles.title: FLEX-LBP: Learning Local Binary Patterns with Exact Binary Inference for Texture Classification
articles.content: Local Binary Patterns (LBP) remain among the most widely used texture descriptors, from industrial inspection to medical imaging. Yet their radius, sampling angles, color transform and thresholds are fixed by hand for each dataset. We present FLEX-LBP, which learns these parameters by backpropagation while every forward pass computes exact binary codes and hard histogram counts. A straight-through estimator acts only in the backward pass, so the deployed descriptor is an interpretable hard-binary LBP with 90 learnable parameters and unchanged inference cost. In a controlled ablation on six color texture benchmarks, the component worth learning is dataset-dependent. One configuration, applied unchanged everywhere, learns the geometry and thresholds with the color transform frozen. It improves the nearest-neighbor accuracy of the identical fixed descriptor by 3.55 points on average over five seeds, significantly on five of six benchmarks and never significantly worse. With a linear discriminant readout, it gains 0.9 points; the fully learned descriptor gains 2.7 and has the highest mean. FLEX-LBP is more accurate than five classical LBP-family descriptors, PCANet and a neural LBP on five of six benchmarks. Its mean nearest-neighbor accuracy exceeds that of frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 features (23.5 million parameters). On the Kather colorectal cancer histology benchmark, the fully learned descriptor reaches 93.8%, significantly above the best classical descriptor (Completed LBP, 92.8%). The learned radii adapt in directions that recur across seeds. Noise drowns single-pixel comparisons and illuminant change flips inter-channel ones; median sampling or gray-world normalization restores 96-97%. The code is available as a drop-in PyTorch layer at https://github.com/medalimoussa/FLEX-LBP.

articles.title_zh: FLEX-LBP:用精确的二进制推论来学习纹理分类的本地二进制模式
articles.content_zh: 从工业检查到医疗成像,当地二进制图案(LBP)仍然是最广泛使用的纹理描述符之一. 然而,它们的半径、采样角度、颜色变换和阈值是用手固定每个数据集的。 我们提出FLEX-LBP,它通过反向传播来学习这些参数,而每一个前传都计算精确的二进制代码和硬直方图计数. 直通估计器只在后传中进行行为,所以部署的描述器是可解释的硬二进制LBP,有90个可学习参数,推论成本不变. 在六种颜色纹理基准的控制下,值得学习的组件依赖于数据集. 一个配置,随处应用不变,随颜色变冷而学习几何和阈值. 它提高了相同固定描述符的近邻准确度,平均在5个种子上提高3.55分,在6个基准中的5个基准上显著提高,而且从未出现过显著的更差. 有了线性歧视读数,它得到0.9分;完全学习的描述器得到2.7分,并且有最高的平均值. FLEX-LBP比五个经典的LBP-家族描述符,PCANet和一个神经LBP更准确,分六个基准中的五个. 它的平均近邻精度超过了冻结的ImageNet ResNet-50特性(2,350万参数). 在Kather色谱癌组织学基准中,完全学习的描述语达到93.8%,大大高于最好的古典描述语(完成LBP,92.8%). 所学的光圈在种子之间反复出现的方向上适应。 噪声会淹没单像素的比较,光亮的变化会翻转通道之间的比较;中位采样或灰世界正常化恢复96-97%. 该代码作为滴入式PyTorch层可访问https://github.com/medalimoussa/FLEX-LBP.

articles.title: Consistent Video-to-Video Translation via Explicit Correspondences
articles.content: Interactive video-to-video applications require real-time generation while maintaining long-range temporal consistency. However, recent methods achieve speed by restricting attention to a fixed-length causal window. This limits long-range consistency whenever relevant history falls outside the context window. To address this limitation, we introduce vid2vid-long, a correspondence-based approach grounded in a simple observation. Video-to-video translation provides an explicit cross-frame reference: the regions that match in the input video should match in the output video too. Concretely, we compute patch-level correspondences in the input, guiding retrieval of previously generated outputs in the corresponding regions, and condition the model on these patches through correspondence cross-attention. Our experiments demonstrate that vid2vid-long consistently improves long-range temporal consistency across recent video models while preserving generation quality and real-time performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过明确的信函进行一致的视频到视频翻译
articles.content_zh: 交互式视频到视频应用需要实时生成,同时保持远程时间一致性. 然而,最近的方法通过将注意力限制在一个固定长度的因果窗口来实现速度. 这限制了在相关历史超出上下文窗口时的远程一致性。 为了解决这一局限性,我们采用了基于简单观察的基于通信的方法。 视频到视频翻译提供了明确的跨框架参考:输入视频中匹配的区域在输出视频中也应当匹配. 具体地说,我们在输入中计算补丁级的函证,指导相应地区以前生成的输出的检索,并通过函证交叉注意在这些补丁上附加模型. 我们的实验表明,vid2vid-long在保持生成质量和实时性能的同时,不断提高近期视频模型的长距离时间一致性.

articles.title: Objects as Addresses: Instance Binding in Vision Transformer Attention
articles.content: Humans naturally parse visual scenes into coherent individual objects rather than scattered features, a capability cognitive science calls object binding. While recent work shows that pretrained Vision Transformers (ViTs) intrinsically acquire this ability, how native self-attention computations mechanistically keep object instances separate remains unresolved. By studying this across eight pretrained ViTs, we found that instance separation is expressed more strongly in attention routing than in token content: selected query-key relations distinguish individual objects more reliably than value similarity or residual representations. Inside heads, patches belonging to one individual tend to read from a common image region, which we term their attention address. Visually distinct parts of one person share an address, whereas identical duplicated instances receive separate, movable addresses. These shared destinations arise in part because query interactions with the spatial structure of keys direct attention toward consistent regions for one object and elsewhere for another. In DINOv2 and most other backbones we tested, editing this query component at the selected head redirects its attention address toward another individual. Grouping patches by this query component separates same-category instances, reaching .615 FG-ARI versus .289 for the same clustering of final-layer features, which tend to merge them.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 地址对象: 图像变形器中绑定的事件
articles.content_zh: 人类自然地将视觉场景剖析成连贯的单个物体而不是分散的特征,一种能力认知科学称物体绑定. 虽然最近的工作显示,预先训练过的视觉变形器(ViTs)在本质上获得了这种能力,但原生的自觉计算如何机械地使对象实例分离的问题仍未解决. 通过对8个经过预先训练的ViTs的研究,我们发现实例分离在注意的路由中比在符号内容中表达得更强烈:选定的查询键关系比价值相似或剩余表示更可靠地区分单个对象. 在头部内部,属于一个人的补丁往往从一个共同的图像区域读取,我们用这个区域来表示他们的注意力地址. 一人视似不同的部分共用一个地址,而相同的重复实例则得到单独的可移动地址。 产生这些共同目的地的部分原因是,对某一物体和另一物体其他地方的一致区域,对钥匙空间结构的相互作用进行查询。 在DINOv2和我们测试过的多数其他骨干中,在选定的头部编辑这个查询组件,将它的注意力地址重定向到另一个个人身上. 按此查询组件分组补丁将同一类实例分开,对于相同的组合最终层特征,其组合往往会合并,则达到615 FG-ARI对289.

articles.title: MALNISI-Infused Graph Construction and Weighted Contrastive Loss based GAT for Unsupervised Representation Learning in HSI
articles.content: Hyperspectral images (HSI) possess discriminating spectral characteristics with respect to land utilization due to high-dimensional information. Recently, unsupervised representation learning using graph neural networks has unveiled these utilization-specific complex spectral relations. This article has three main contributions. First, it proposes an index, the Mean Absolute Local Neighborhood Inverse Spectral Index (MALNISI), which measures the similarity between two pixels based on their neighborhood information. The index is used to construct a weighted adjacency matrix, giving the HSI a graph structure. Second, it proposes an upgraded Graph Attention Network that learns compact latent representations of hyperspectral data from the constructed graph. In this network, an enhanced multi-head attention mechanism incorporates the MALNISI weights as an auxiliary feature to emphasize learned attention between neighboring pixels. To alleviate over-smoothing and preserve fine-grained spectral details, the architecture integrates residual connections, skip projections, and feature normalization, which together enhance representation capability, stabilize learning, and accelerate convergence. Third, it proposes a weighted contrastive loss function that incorporates neighborhood-aware MALNISI between connected pixels, encouraging strongly connected pixels in the high-dimensional space to remain close in the latent space, and weakly connected pixels to stay apart. The resulting discriminative low-dimensional embeddings are then clustered using spectral clustering. Experimental analysis on six benchmark HSI datasets demonstrates the efficiency and necessity of the three aforementioned contributions, and the comparative study highlights superior performance over fourteen state-of-the-art approaches.

articles.title_zh: MARNISI-插入图建设和加权对比损失
articles.content_zh: 超光谱图象(HSI)由于高维度信息,在土地利用方面具有不同的光谱特征。 最近,利用图神经网络进行的无监督的表达学习揭示了这些与利用相关的复杂光谱关系。 本条有三个主要贡献。 首先,它提出了一个指数,即"平均绝对局部邻里反光谱指数"(MALNISI),根据邻里信息来测量两个像素之间的相似性. 该指数用于构建一个加权的辅音矩阵,给HSI一个图表结构. 第二,它提议建立一个升级后的图表关注网络,从构建的图表中学习超光谱数据的紧凑潜在表示。 在这个网络中,一个增强的多头关注机制将MALNISI的权重作为辅助功能,强调邻居像素之间学到的注意. 为了缓解过度疏松和保存精细的光谱细节,该架构整合了剩余连接,跳过预测,并具有特征的正常化,这些都共同提高了表达能力,稳定了学习,加速了趋同. 第三,它提出一个加权对比性丢失函数,在连接像素之间纳入邻里感知的MALNISI,鼓励高维空间中紧密连接的像素在潜在空间中保持紧密,弱连接的像素保持隔离. 由此产生的差别低维嵌入物再利用光谱集群进行集群. 对六套基准HSI数据集的实验分析表明上述三项贡献的效率和必要性,比较研究突出了超过十四项最新办法的优异业绩。

articles.title: eDMD: Endpoint Distribution Matching for Few-Step Diffusion Distillation
articles.content: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) has emerged as a leading paradigm for distilling diffusion models into few-step students, where an auxiliary fake score model tracks the student's distribution and the discrepancy between the teacher and fake predictions drives the student toward the teacher. In multi-step distillation, although only the student's final output is delivered, existing methods train the fake model on intermediate states or across all denoising steps. Consequently, the student's update signal becomes entangled with intermediate distributions, which can distort the matching direction and remain nonzero even after the student's final outputs already match the teacher distribution. To resolve this mismatch, we propose Endpoint Distribution Matching Distillation (eDMD), which trains a single shared fake model exclusively on the student's final outputs and uses it to correct every denoising step. Our theoretical analysis proves that this endpoint reference guarantees that the distribution matching term vanishes if and only if the student's final output distribution matches the teacher's, regardless of intermediate distributions. Beyond the fake reference, we further strengthen teacher supervision through a precise teacher (PT) that replaces single-step guided predictions with short multi-step trajectories on the final noise interval, paired with a calibrated query density for intermediate steps. Experiments on SD3-Medium, FLUX.2-klein (4B and 9B), and Qwen-Image-2.1 demonstrate that eDMD consistently outperforms existing distribution matching methods for 4-step generation.

articles.title_zh: eDMD: 极少数阶段传播的终点分布匹配
articles.content_zh: 分配匹配蒸馏(DMD)已成为将扩散模型蒸馏成少部分学生的主导范式,其中辅助假分模型跟踪学生的分布以及教师与假预测之间的差异,促使学生走向教师. 在多步骤蒸馏中,虽然只有学生的最终产出交付,但现有方法在中间状态上或在所有去诺步骤上训练假模型. 因此,学生的更新信号会与中间分布缠绕在一起,这可以扭曲匹配方向,即使在学生的最终产出已经与教师分布相匹配后仍保持非零. 为了解决这一不匹配问题,我们提出 Endpoint Discription(eDMD) ,它专门在学生的最终产出上训练一个共享的假模型,并用它来纠正每一个去名步骤. 我们的理论分析证明,这个端点参考保证了分配匹配术语消失,只要学生的最终产出分配与老师匹配,无论中间分配如何. 除了假的参考,我们通过精确的老师(PT)进一步加强教师监督,在最终噪声间隔上用短的多步导轨取代单步导导导导预测,并配以校准的查询密度进行中间步骤. 在SD3-Medium,FLUX.2-Klein(4B和9B)和Quen-Image-2.1上的实验表明,eDMD在4步生成方面一贯超越现有的分布匹配方法.

articles.title: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
articles.content: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves. Over a busy intersection, vehicles moving together supply mutually consistent correspondences that can draw the robust homography estimate toward their motion: consensus capture, which inlier statistics cannot flag. A two-part benchmark measures it and the object masking meant to prevent it. A static protocol scores ten pipelines under exactly known homographies on 4K aerial frames, tuned on a site-disjoint split at a matched resolution and feature budget. A dynamic protocol scores them at an offline and a real-time budget on hovers selected from the video alone to span the amount and coherence of moving foreground, plus a stationary control. It measures background alignment, object position error and the share of a moving group's displacement an estimate follows, against a pseudo-ground-truth reference audited with manually annotated ground control points, which also score every candidate. On static scenes, tuned AKAZE, RootSIFT, SIFT and BRISK lead, retuning the matcher thresholds raises the mean average accuracy (mAA) by at most 0.0062, and masking costs less than 0.005. Unmasked ORB is captured on 28 of 304 real-time dynamic pairs and on 6 offline; its real-time captured estimates have a median corner error of 18.8 px yet typical inlier counts and ratios. Masking removes capture for every pipeline and leaves the leading pipelines unchanged. Code, data and results are released.

articles.title_zh: 基于参考的无人驾驶航空器中的共识捕捉 视频稳定:动态城市情景基准
articles.content_zh: 参照框架稳定记录了每个悬浮式视频的帧到一个参照框架,使物体位置具有可比性。 它所依赖的注册管道是根据只有相机移动的特征匹配基准选择的. 在繁忙的交叉路口上,车辆一起移动,提供相互一致的通信,可以引领强烈的图谱学估计走向他们的动作:协商一致的捕捉,而更强烈的统计不能标榜这一点。 由两部分组成的基准衡量它和物体遮盖是为了防止它。 静态协议在4K空中架设的完全已知的同位素下对10条管道进行评分,根据匹配的分辨率和特征预算,以一个站点-分离的分割进行调制. 动态协议在离线时给它们评分,而实时预算则只从视频中选择盘旋,以覆盖移动前景的数量和一致性,再加上固定控制. 它对照经过人工注释的地面控制点审计的伪地面真实参考,衡量背景调整、对象位置错误和移动组移位的比例。 在静态场景中,调制了AKAZE,RootSIFT,SIFT和BRISK的铅,重新调整了匹配器阈值,将平均平均精度(mAA)提升了最多0.062,遮掩成本低于0.005. 304个实时动态对中的28个和6个离线捕获未装模作样的ORB;其实时捕获的估计数中位角误差为18.8 px,但典型的更强计数和比值. 面具可以清除每条管道的捕获量,使主要管道保持不变。 代码,数据和结果发布.

articles.title: Neural Render Proxies for Interactive and Differentiable Lighting
articles.content: Within the CG animation production pipeline, the challenges artists tackle in Lighting can be immense. Even minor adjustments require re-rendering massive scenes with slow offline renderers; global illumination has to be sampled and complex shaders have to be evaluated, leading to iteration times of minutes to hours per frame. To accelerate this process, we introduce a novel neural render proxy (NRP) that enables differentiable relighting of static scenes with fixed camera and materials at interactive rates. Our main insight is the decoupling of traditional rendering into path sampling and emission computation. From a single, light-agnostic render pass, we collect light transport data in the form of path samples. This enables rapidly sampling lighting conditions on the fly, and training a scene-specific lightweight neural network that learns how light is transported from any scene location to any image pixel. This approach is compatible with non-differentiable production renderers, induces minimal memory requirements during inference, and scales only with resolution and the number of light sources and parameters, but independently of scene and appearance complexity. Our evaluation demonstrates interactive frame rates for relighting (~30-60 Hz) while closely approximating the visual fidelity of ground-truth path tracing. In addition, the differentiable NRP enables fast, gradient-based inverse workflows, allowing artists to efficiently solve for lighting parameters from intuitive image-space edits or generative targets.

articles.title_zh: 交互和可区分照明的神经电源代理
articles.content_zh: 在CG动画制作管道中,艺术家们在照明中应对的挑战可能是巨大的. 即使是小的调整,也需要用慢的离线渲染器重新投放大面积场景;全球照明必须取样,复杂的遮阳器必须加以评价,导致每个帧的重复时间为分钟到小时. 为了加快这一过程,我们引入了一个新的神经渲染代用(NRP),能够以互动的速度用固定的相机和材料对静态场景进行可变的重燃. 我们的主要见解是将传统渲染与路径取样和排放计算脱钩。 从一个单一的,光不可知的渲染通过,我们以路径样本的形式收集光传输数据. 这使得能迅速取样苍蝇上的照明条件,并训练一个场景特有的轻量级神经网络,学习光如何从任何场景位置传送到任何图像像素. 这种方法与无差别的制作渲染器兼容,在推论过程中诱导最小的内存要求,尺度只与分辨率以及光源和参数的数量相适应,但独立于场景和外观复杂性. 我们的评价显示,重燃(~30-60赫兹)的交互式帧率,同时密切接近地面-真实路径追踪的视觉可靠性。 此外,不同的NRP可以快速,基于梯度的反向工作流程,使艺术家能够从直观的图像空间编辑或基因目标中有效解决照明参数.

articles.title: Validation-Guided Prompt Selection for Differential Morphing Attack Detection
articles.content: Differential morphing attack detection (D-MAD) compares a trusted live capture with a document image that may contain a facial morph. We investigate whether labelled validation data can improve a frozen-parameter vision-language evaluator through prompt selection rather than model fine-tuning. Version~1 generates 50 candidate prompts and selects the top-ranked instruction using a security-oriented loss that prioritises missed morph attacks (MACER) while accounting for bona fide classification errors (BSCER), response failures, parse failures, and decision inconsistency. Version~2 recursively revises prompts using aggregate validation feedback. On a subject-disjoint test set of 160 pairs spanning LMA, MIPGAN-2, and PIPE, the selected Version~1 prompt achieves a (19.17\%) morph attack classification error rate (MACER), with (0.00\%) observed bona fide sample classification error rate (BSCER), compared with (70.00\%) MACER for a controlled manual prompt. The paired (50.83) percentage-point difference has a (95\%) subject-bootstrap interval of ([43.33,58.33]). Recursive revision does not surpass the best Generation~0 validation loss; the reported revised descendant obtains (31.67\%) test MACER. All 23 attacks missed by Version~1 are landmark-based (LMA) morphs. Overall, the results show that prompt formulation can substantially influence frozen-parameter VLM-based D-MAD performance, while also highlighting the challenge of recursive prompt refinement under a compact 10-subject validation setting.

articles.title_zh: 校验 - 引导 快速选择不同振荡攻击检测
articles.content_zh: 不同的形态攻击探测(D-MAD)将可信任的现场捕捉与可能包含面部形态的文档图像进行比较. 我们调查标注的验证数据是否能够通过迅速选择而不是模型微调来改进一个冷冻参数的视觉语言评价员。 版本~1生成50个候选的提示,并使用面向安全的损失来选择排名最高的指令,该损失在计算善意分类错误(BSCER),响应失败,解析失败,以及决定不一致时,优先忽略了形态攻击(MACER). 版本~2利用汇总验证反馈对提示进行递归修改. 在160对跨越LMA,MIPGAN-2和PIPE的试题-脱节测试集上,所选版本~1的即时实现一个(19.17\%)形态攻击分类误差率(MACER),(0.00\%)观测到的善意样品分类误差率(BSCER)与(70.00\%)相比. MACER用于控制手动提示. 成对(50.83)百分点的差值(95\%)为([43.33,58.33])。 递归性修订并不超过最佳的Generation~0验证损失;报告的修订后后裔获得(31.67\%)测试MACER. 版本~1错过的所有23次攻击都是基于地标的(LMA)形态. 总体而言,结果显示,快速配制可大大影响基于VLM的冷冻参数D-MAD的性能,同时也突出了在紧凑的10个主题验证环境下进行递归性快速改进的挑战。

articles.title: SpotDiff: A Plug-and-Play Framework for Zero-Shot Change Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
articles.content: Remote sensing change detection usually relies on large collections of temporally aligned, pixel-level annotations, which limits its scalability across regions, imaging platforms and application domains. Recent zero-shot approaches reduce the need for supervision, but they often localize fine-grained changes poorly because their features are coarse or inconsistent across time. We present SpotDiff, a training-free, plug-and-play framework for zero-shot change detection built by composing complementary vision foundation models. SpotDiff uses DINOv3 for semantically robust features, AnyUp to reconstruct them at pixel resolution, and SAM 3 for text-guided region-of-interest proposals, which an inference-time multi-scale strategy (SWIMS) makes reliable on small objects. Change is then measured by comparing the reconstructed features of the two dates inside the proposed regions, with no learnable components, fine-tuning or change labels. To our knowledge, SpotDiff is the first change detection method to use a universal feature upsampler, which alone adds 13.8 F1 over bilinear upsampling of the same features. On LEVIR-CD, SpotDiff reaches 82.46 F1, 2.06 points above the strongest prior training-free method, and on the multi-class SECOND benchmark it improves building change detection by 10.3 IoU and the six-class average by 2.2 IoU. Qualitative results on PlanetScope (3 m) and Sentinel-2 (10 m) imagery show that the same pipeline transfers across resolutions without modification. Our results indicate that composing modern foundation models is an effective route to scalable, label-free change detection.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SpotDiff:遥感图像零热变化探测插件和插件框架
articles.content_zh: 遥感变化探测通常依赖于大量时间对齐,像素级说明的集合,这限制了其跨区域,成像平台和应用域的伸缩性. 近期的零射法减少了监督的必要性,但是它们往往将精细的磨损变化本地化,因为其特征粗糙,或者在一段时间内不一致. 我们介绍SpotDiff,一个无训练的,插件和游戏的零镜头变化检测框架,通过构建互补的视觉基础模型而构建. SpotDiff使用DINOv3来进行凝聚性强的特性,AnyUp在像素分辨率下重建它们,SAM 3则用于文本引导的利益区域建议,一个推论-时间多尺度策略(SWIMS)使得小对象上可靠. 然后通过比较拟议区域内两个日期的重建特征来衡量变化,没有可学习的组件,微调或更改标签. 据我们所知,SpotDiff是第一种使用通用特征提升标本的变换检测方法,仅此一项就比同一特征的双线提升标本增加了13.8 F1. 在LEVIR-CD上,SpotDiff比以往最强的无训练方法高82.46 F1,2.06分,在多级二等基准上,它改进了10.3IoU的建筑变化探测,6级平均值为2.2IoU. PlanetScope(3米)和Sentinel-2(10米)图像的质量结果显示,同一管道在分辨率之间不作修改转移。 我们的结果显示,构建现代基础模型是可扩展,无标签变化检测的有效途径.

articles.title: UAV-Flow++: A Unified Suite for Benchmarking and Learning Language-Guided UAV Flight
articles.content: Language-guided UAV navigation has largely focused on long-horizon route planning, leaving short-range, object-relative flight maneuvers underexplored. To address this gap, we formulate Flying-on-a-Word (Flow), a task requiring a UAV to convert concise natural-language instruction, egocentric visual observation, and current state dynamics into continuous flight actions. Flow encompasses both primitive motion commands and complex object-interactive behaviors, assessing motion intent comprehension and spatial context grounding. To enable policy learning and closed-loop evaluation, we introduce UAV-Flow, a comprehensive dataset comprising 30,692 expert-piloted real-world trajectories across eight distinct motion categories, alongside 10,109 simulation trajectories in the UAV-Flow-Sim environment equipped with task-specific completion criteria. Furthermore, we develop FlowVLA, which undergoes imitation pretraining on mixed real-sim demonstrations and online post-training via Tail-Aware GRPO (TGRPO). By leveraging group reward distributions, TGRPO effectively reinforces high-reward action sequences. Evaluated on 273 held-out UAV-Flow-Sim episodes, pretrained FlowVLA achieves a mean success rate of 75.58%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.72 percentage points, which TGRPO post-training further elevates to 93.16% with superior sample efficiency. Physical UAV experiments demonstrate robust execution of object-relative commands in both indoor and outdoor real-world scenes. Together, Flow establishes a novel benchmark and learning framework for language-conditioned flight maneuvers.

articles.title_zh: UAV-Flow++:用于基准和学习语言指导的UAV飞行的统一套件
articles.content_zh: 语言制导的无人机导航主要侧重于长视距航线规划,使得短程,对象相对的飞行动作探索不足. 为了弥补这一差距,我们制定了“飞翔一字”(Flow)任务,要求无人机将简明的自然语言教学、自我中心视觉观察和当前状态动态转化为持续的飞行行动。 流动既包括原始运动指令,也包括复杂的物体交互行为,评估运动意向理解和空间背景定位. 为了能够进行政策学习和闭路评估,我们采用了无人驾驶飞行器-飞行器(UAV-Flow)综合数据集,其中包括30 692个专家驾驶的、跨越八个不同运动类别的现实世界轨迹,以及10 109个具有特定任务完成标准的无人驾驶飞行器-飞行系统环境中的模拟轨迹。 此外,我们开发了FlowVLA,它通过Tail-Aware GRPO(TGRPO)进行模拟性实景演示预训和在线后培训。 通过利用团体奖励分配,TGRPO有效地强化了高回报动作序列. 通过对273起UAV-Flow-Sim事件进行评估,经过预先培训的FlowVLA取得了75.58%的中度成功率,比最强的基线高6.72个百分点,TGRPO在培训后进一步提升到93.16%,具有较高的样本效率。 物理无人驾驶航空器实验表明,在室内外现实世界的场景中,对物体相关指令的有力执行。 " 流动 " 共同为具备语言条件的飞行操作建立了一个新的基准和学习框架。

articles.title: HiVE-VQA: Hierarchical Interaction via Volumetric Embedding for Video Quality Assessment
articles.content: The proliferation of user-generated video content has made accurate and robust no-reference video quality assessment (NR-VQA) a highly important challenge. Existing research increasingly relies on architecturally complex multi-branch pipelines or computationally intensive fine-tuning of single-branch backbones. In this paper, we investigate whether a single frozen video foundation model can serve as an effective NR-VQA backbone, and propose HiVE-VQA, the first framework (to our knowledge) to apply a JEPA-based video encoder to this task. HiVE-VQA extracts token grids from multiple depths of a pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder and stacks them into a hierarchical spatio-temporal volume, which a compact 3D convolutional head fuses across its layer, spatial, and temporal axes, combining low-level distortion cues from shallow layers with the semantic and temporal context captured at greater depths. The encoder remains frozen throughout, so only the head is trained: 5.2M parameters (5.7\% of the total), with no auxiliary multi-modal models and an inference cost that is invariant to video resolution. Trained solely on LSVQ and evaluated without any fine-tuning, HiVE-VQA outperforms 17 state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in SROCC and PLCC on both intra-dataset (LSVQ-test, LSVQ-1080p) and cross-dataset (KoNViD-1k, LIVE-VQC) benchmarks. These results indicate that hierarchical, depth-wise fusion of features from a single frozen video foundation model provides a more effective and efficient basis for NR-VQA than task-specific multi-network fusion. Code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RobHam99/HiVE-VQA.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HIVE-VQA:通过量子嵌入进行视频质量评估的分级互动
articles.content_zh: 用户生成的视频内容激增,使得准确而有力的无参考视频质量评估(NR-VQA)成为一项非常重要的挑战. 现有的研究越来越依赖于建筑复杂的多分支管线或计算密集的单分支骨干微调. 在本文中,我们调查单一的冷冻视频基础模型是否能够作为有效的NR-VQA主干,并提议Hive-VQA,这是(据我们所知)将基于JEPA的视频编码器应用到这项任务的第一个框架. HiVE-VQA从预先训练的V-JEPA 2.1编码器的多深度中提取代号网格,并将其堆积成一个层次分明的螺旋-时空体积,一个紧凑的3D演化头部在它的地层,空间,和时间轴上引信,将浅层的低水平扭曲提示与在更深处捕获的语义和时间背景相结合. 编码器在整个过程中保持冷冻,所以只有头部被训练:5.2M参数(占总数的5.7×××),没有辅助的多模式模型,推论成本对视频解析度来说是变化无常的. 仅就LSVQ进行训练,未经任何微调评价,Hive-VQA在SROCC和PLCC在内部数据集(LSVQ测试,LSVQ-1080p)和跨数据集(KoNViD-1k,LIVE-VQC)基准上都超过了17个最先进的(SOTA)方法. 这些结果表明,从一个单一的冷冻视频基础模型中分层、深度地对特性进行整合,为NR-VQA提供了比针对特定任务的多网络整合更有效和更高效的基础。 在https://github.com/RobHam99/HiVE-VQA上可查询代码和示范检查站。

articles.title: STeP-C: Real-Time Neural Compression for Distributed Fiber-Optic Sensing at Scale
articles.content: Distributed fiber-optic sensing (DFOS) technologies such as Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) generate continuous, high-resolution spatio-temporal data at rates exceeding hundreds of megabytes per second, creating severe challenges for real-time storage and transmission. While neural compression methods can achieve strong rate-distortion performance on sensing data, prior approaches either require per-segment retraining incompatible with streaming, or have only been validated offline. None have been demonstrated end-to-end on a continuously streaming DAS acquisition system at scale. We present STeP-C (Spatio-Temporal Predictive Compression), a neural compression framework that decouples spatial encoding, temporal prediction, and entropy-optimized residual coding, trained end-to-end with a rate-distortion objective motivated by conditional entropy reduction. Critically, we identify entropy coding as the dominant bottleneck for streaming deployment. We address it through GPU-side symbol computation, cached probability tables, and parallel GIL-free arithmetic coding, together with FP16 inference and batched entropy coding, enabling a full real-time pipeline built around a GPU ring buffer. We validate this pipeline on a live DAS testbed, achieving a 98.85% file size reduction at 31.04 dB full-band PSNR and an average throughput of 535 MB/s, exceeding the 324 MB/s requirement for 1 kHz, 81 km DAS streams. We further show that STeP-C substantially outperforms conventional codecs at practical streaming bitrates, can be applied to unseen channel ranges within the same acquisition system without retraining, and largely maintains downstream detector consistency, with 96.62% high-confidence class agreement and 100% Jaccard similarity on detected event types.

articles.title_zh: STeP-C:按比例分布的纤维-振荡的实时神经压缩
articles.content_zh: 分布式光纤感测(DFOS)技术如分布式声学感测(DAS)以超过每秒数百兆字节的速度生成连续高分辨率的时空数据,对实时存储和传输造成严重的挑战. 虽然神经压缩方法可以在感知数据上实现强烈的速率扭曲性能,但之前的方法要么要求每个区段的再培训与流化不兼容,要么只经过离线验证. 在不断流传的DAS采购系统上,没有任何一个端到端经过论证。 我们提出STeP-C(英语:Spatio-Temporal Presidentive Compression),是一种神经压缩框架,可以解开空间编码,时间预测,以及肽-优化的剩余编码,经过训练的端到端都具有以有条件的肽还原为动机的速率扭曲目标. 关键的是,我们确定 en编码是流派部署的主要瓶颈。 我们通过GPU侧符号计算,缓存概率表,和平行的GIL无算术编码,连同FP16推论和批量的 en编码来解决这个问题,使得能围绕GPU环缓冲器建造全实时管道. 我们在实时的DAS试验台上验证了这一管道,在31.04 dB全波段PSNR上实现了98.85%的文件尺寸削减,平均吞吐量为535 MB/s,超过了1千赫,81千米DAS流的324 MB/s要求. 我们进一步显示,STeP-C在实际流速比特率上大大超过常规的编码器,可以在不进行再培训的情况下应用到同一获取系统内的看不见的信道范围,并且基本上保持下游探测器的一致性,在检测到的事件类型上有96.62%的高自信级协议和100%的Jaccar相似性.

articles.title: Spatiotemporal learning improves quantification of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement
articles.content: Pore-space evolution and fluid displacement influence how rocks transmit and store fluids, affecting geological carbon storage, underground hydrogen storage and groundwater contaminant transport. A single time-resolved micro-CT experiment may produce tens to hundreds of three-dimensional images, and segmentation is required to quantify physical properties and run image-based simulations. Traditional methods such as thresholding perform poorly on noisy, low-contrast images and need manual adjustment per image; 3D deep learning networks segment each image without temporal information, so their errors vary between images and could be mistaken for physical change. Here we introduce a transformer-based 4D segmentation framework combining spatial and temporal information. It uses sequential images to resolve ambiguous phase assignments and separate physical change from segmentation error. The method is tested on images of mineral dissolution: it measures pore-volume growth and rock boundaries more accurately than an equivalent 3D model that ignores temporal information. It also captures the increase in permeability verified against reference segmentations and flow simulations. The advantage transfers to another dissolution sample without retraining. On two other datasets of fluid displacement, it reduces spurious changes in predicted rock and porosity fluctuations and accurately identifies filling events. Spatiotemporal segmentation turns sequences of hundreds of three-dimensional images into more reliable quantitative measurements of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement without per-image parameter adjustment to support the analysis of time-resolved CT imaging.

articles.content_zh: 孔隙空间演化和流体转移影响岩石传递和储存流体的方式,影响地质碳储存,地下氢储存和地下水污染物迁移. 单个时间解的微CT实验可以产生数十到数百个三维图像,分解需要量化物理性质和运行基于图像的模拟. 诸如阈值等传统方法在吵吵闹闹的低调图像上表现不佳,每个图像都需要手动调整;3D深层学习网络将每个图像片断,没有时间信息,因此其错误因图像而异,可能误认为是物理变化. 在这里,我们引入了基于变压器的4D分解框架,结合了空间和时间信息. 它使用顺序图像来解决模棱两可的相位任务,并将物理变化与分割错误区分开来. 该方法通过矿物溶解的图像进行测试:它比忽略时间信息的等效立体模型更准确地测量孔径生长和岩石边界. 它还记录了参照分解和流量模拟核实的渗透性增加。 好处是在没有再培训的情况下转移到另一个解散样本。 在另外两个流体迁移数据集上,它减少了预测的岩石和孔隙波动的虚假变化,并准确地识别填充事件. spatiotemporal partication 将数百个三维图像的序列转换成更可靠的定量测量孔隙空间演化和流体位移,而无需每个图像参数调整,以支持时间解的CT成像分析.

articles.title: Predicting Ethanol Drinking Status from Nonhuman Primate Liver Histology: A Proof of Concept for Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Few-Shot Vision-Language Modeling
articles.content: Combining vision-language models (VLMs) with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a promising approach to few-shot whole-slide image (WSI) classification in computational pathology. This study evaluates this approach for predicting ethanol drinking status from nonhuman primate liver histology. Adapters are evaluated against non-PEFT configurations on a subset of the Monkey Alcohol Tissue Research Resource (MATRR). All evaluated PEFT configurations achieve higher mean balanced accuracy than the non-PEFT baselines. For example, in the four-shot setting, attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) alone achieves 43.5% mean balanced accuracy, compared with 78.1% after adding an adapter. Qualitative attention analysis shows that textual pathway adaptations produce localized attention heatmaps, while visual pathway adaptations produce more diffuse ones. A pathologist's review identified similar histological features across adaptations.

articles.title_zh: 预测伊桑诺酒饮用状况,来自非人类先锋活者史学: 参数高效精细调试概念的证明, 少部分热景-语言模型
articles.content_zh: 将视觉语言模型(VLMs)与参数效率微调(PEFT)相结合,为在计算病理学中进行几发全滑图像(WSI)分类提供了一个很有希望的方法. 本研究评价了从非人类灵长类肝脏组织学中预测乙醇饮用状态的方法. 在猴子酒精组织研究资源(MATRR)的一个子集上,对照非PEFT配置来评价适配器. 所有经过评价的PEFT配置都实现了高于非PEFT基线的平均值平衡准确度. 例如,在四拍设定中,仅基于注意力的多实例学习(ABMIL)就实现了43.5%的均衡精度,而在添加了适配器后则达到了78.1%。 定性关注分析显示,文字路径适应产生局部关注热图,而视觉路径适应则产生更分散的热图. 一位病理学家的审查发现,在各种适应中,类似的组织特征。

articles.title: TuMAP: A Dual-View, Morphotype-Aware Pathomics Pipeline for Quantifying Renal Tubular Remodeling
articles.content: Quantifying disease-associated renal tubular remodeling is challenging because tubular appearances are heterogeneous. We introduce TuMAP (Tubular Morphotype-Aware Pathomics), a pipeline combining (1) dual-view foundation-model representations and provisional morphotype annotation, (2) compositional and within-morphotype pathomics, and (3) patient-level statistical inference. From 456,158 tubules in 358 PAS-stained kidney biopsy slides, TuMAP identified eight image-based morphotypes, seven of which showed stable subsampling assignments. Across 219 patients in six diagnostic groups, diabetic nephropathy (DN) and tubulointerstitial nephritis/acute tubular injury (TIN/ATI) each differed from minimal change disease in seven morphotype proportions, while IgA nephropathy differed in six. DN showed reduced nuclear solidity and increased eccentricity across all eight morphotypes. Area-normalized nuclear density exposed additional within-morphotype differences. TuMAP provides a framework for separating changes in tubular morphotype composition from phenotypic differences within morphotypes.

articles.title: Joint Null-Space Projection for Data-Free Model Merging
articles.content: Merging independently fine-tuned checkpoints into a single multi-task model requires no data, no labels, and no gradient steps. In practice the task vectors of different tasks interfere, and the standard remedies--averaging, magnitude pruning, sign election--operate entry by entry, ignoring that each delta induces a low-dimensional update on the hidden features it acts upon. We recast merging as a subspace interference problem. For every two-dimensional weight tensor we take the top-r right-singular subspace of each task's delta--the input directions along which that task moves the representation most--and remove from each task vector the component lying in the union of the other tasks' subspaces. The resulting Joint Null-Space Projection (JNSP) is closed-form and order-independent, needs no forward pass, and is defined entirely by the checkpoint set. On eight CLIP image-classification tasks JNSP merges ViT-B/16 experts to 89.45% average accuracy without using a single image, 11.88 points above the strongest parameter-wise training-free baseline (TIES-Merging, 77.57%), 14.22 above Task Arithmetic, and 0.98 above WUDI's data-free consensus merge (88.47%). The gain holds across three backbones on the independently trained TALL release (+10.8, +12.6, +9.1 over TIES for ViT-B/16, ViT-B/32, ViT-L/14) and replicates there at 89.20%; controls confirm the source--a single shared subspace instead of per-task ones loses 2.9 points, and a sequential variant collapses to 69.6%. On RoBERTa-large the same projection underperforms plain task arithmetic, which we report rather than hide. Code is available at https://github.com.

articles.title_zh: 无数据模型联合Null-Space投影
articles.content_zh: 将独立的微调检查站合并为单一的多任务模式不需要数据、标签和梯度步骤。 在实践中,不同任务的任务矢量会干扰,标准补救-averaging,量冲,通过条目签名选举-操作输入,忽略了每个三角洲会诱导低维更新它所作用的隐藏特性. 我们把合并重编成亚空间干扰问题 对于每个二维的重角,我们取每个任务三角形的右上角的子空间—— 输入方向,该任务沿这个方向移动代表,从每个任务矢量中去除存在于其他任务子空间结合中的组件。 由此产生的联合Null-Space投影(JNSP)是封闭形式和命令独立的,不需要前进通道,完全由检查站设置来定义. 在八项CLIP图像分类任务上,JNSP将VIT-B/16专家合并到89.45 %的平均精度而不使用单一图像,11.88分高于最强参数无训练基线(TIES-Merging,77.57%),14.22分高于任务算术,0.98分高于WUDI的数据无数据共识合并(88.47%). 该增益在经过独立培训的TALL发布(+10.8,+12.6,+9.1比TIES为VIT-B/16,VIT-B/32,VIT-L/14)上占据了三个主干,并在那里复制89.20%;控制确认源-一个单一共享的子空间而不是每个任务共享的子空间损失2.9分,一个相继变体崩溃到69.6%. 在 RoBERTa 的宽度上,同样的投影效果不足 平面任务算术, 我们报告而不是隐藏。 代码可见于https://github.com.

articles.title: SALT: State-Aligned Low-Rank Transfer for Single-Temporal Cross-Dataset Structural Localization in Remote Sensing
articles.content: Change detection in remote sensing conventionally relies on spatially aligned bi-temporal imagery, which may be unavailable or unreliable in practical scenarios. Recent single-temporal approaches address this limitation by learning structural evidence, such as building regions, from a labeled source dataset and transferring it to unseen target imagery using only the current image. However, adaptation to the source dataset can over-specialize pretrained features and reduce their cross-dataset generalization, a risk that this paper argues is higher when the feature adaptation is parameterized independently of the states used for prediction. To address this issue, the current study introduces SALT, a State-Aligned Low-Rank Transfer framework. SALT keeps a DINOv3 backbone frozen and learns negative and positive structural states that both score each patch and, through State-Aligned Low-Rank Adaptation (SALA), span the rank-2 subspace in which patch features are corrected. Directional State Alignment supervises these corrections to raise the evidence of positive patches and lower that of negative ones, while Geometry Preservation limits changes to the pairwise relations among pretrained patch features. Experiments on LEVIR-CD and the WHU aerial building dataset show that, at the pixel level and in both transfer directions, SALT outperforms four baselines reproduced under a common source-only protocol, improving over the strongest reproduced baselines by 9.45 and 5.79 points in pixel-level AP and by 27.69 and 14.25 points in IoU (LEVIR-CD to WHU and WHU to LEVIR-CD, respectively), with only 0.068M trainable parameters and 40.2 ms per image. In order to facilitate reproducibility and further research, the source code of SALT is available at https://github.com/gthpapadopoulos/SALT

articles.title_zh: SALT:用于遥感领域单时跨数据集结构定位的国与国之间的低辐射转移
articles.content_zh: 遥感的变化探测通常依靠空间对齐的双时段图像,而这种图像在实际情况下可能无法提供或不可靠。 最近的单一时段方法通过学习结构证据,例如建筑区域,从标注的源数据集到仅使用当前图像的不见目标图像,来解决这一局限性。 然而,对源数据集的适应可以过度专门化预先训练的特征,并减少其跨数据集的概括性,本文认为,当特征适应独立于用于预测的状态参数化时,这种风险更高. 为了解决这一问题,本研究报告引入了SALT,即国家结盟低辐射转移框架。 SALT保持一个DINOv3主干线冷冻,并学习负和正结构态,每个补丁都得分,并通过州-州低Rank适应(SALA)跨越校正补丁特征的级别-2子空间. 定向状态校正监督这些校正,以提出正补丁的证据并降低负补丁的证据,而几何保存则限制预先训练的补丁特征之间的对偶关系变化. 对LEVIR-CD和WHU空中建筑数据集的实验表明,在像素水平和两个转动方向上,SALT都超过了根据共同的唯源协议复制的4个基线,比最强的再生基线在像素水平AP上提高了9.45和5.79分,在IoU上提高了27.69和14.25分(分别是LEVIR-CD到WHU和WHU到LEVIR-CD),只有0.068M可列车参数和每幅图像40.2 ms. 为了便于复制和进一步研究,SALT的源代码见https://github.com/gthpadopoulos/SALT。

articles.title: Ropedia Xperience 2: A Gold Standard for Scaling Physical AI Environments and Behaviors
articles.content: Large foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have recently been shown to control robots directly from visual observations. They nevertheless remain brittle on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks in real-world environments. Further progress depends on two complementary resources: demonstrations of human behavior that supervise how tasks are performed, and interactive environments in which policies can be rolled out, evaluated, and improved in closed loop. Language models have advanced along well-characterized scaling laws; the corresponding question for physical AI is how capability scales with environments and behaviors, which first requires identifying which data to scale and how to produce and reuse such data continuously. To address this question, we introduce Ropedia Xperience 2, comprising 1,589 released metric-scale 3D scans and a collection of 4,230 egocentric recordings of 74 tasks (131 hours). We further show that each capture can be repurposed for robot learning: scenes are converted into physically interactive simulation environments, human motion is retargeted to whole-body robot trajectories, and additional robot behaviors are obtained through virtual teleoperation and automated long-horizon trajectory generation. We propose this joint capture of environments and behaviors as a gold standard for physical AI data collection, laying a data foundation for establishing scaling laws over environments and behaviors.

articles.title_zh: Ropedia Xperience 2: 放大物理AI环境和行为的黄金标准
articles.content_zh: 最近显示GPT-6 Astra和Claude Fable 5.1等大型基础模型直接通过视觉观测控制机器人. 然而,在现实环境中,它们仍然在漫长的、富于接触的任务上步履维艰。 进一步的进展取决于两种补充资源:监督如何执行任务的人类行为示范,以及可以将政策推出、评价和在封闭循环中加以改进的互动环境。 语言模型沿着特征鲜明的缩放定律前进;物理AI的相应问题是,在环境和行为方面的能力尺度如何,这首先需要确定哪些数据可以缩放,以及如何持续生成和再利用这些数据。 为了解决这一问题,我们介绍了Ropedia Xperience 2, 其中包括1,589个已发布的公尺级3D扫描和4,230个以自我为中心的74项任务(131小时)的录音。 我们进一步显示,每次捕获都可以重新用于机器人学习:场景被转换为物理交互模拟环境,人类运动被重新瞄准全身机器人轨迹,并通过虚拟远程操作和自动长视轨迹生成获得额外的机器人行为. 我们提议联合捕获环境和行为,作为物理AI数据收集的金本位标准,为制定超越环境和行为的法律奠定数据基础.

articles.title: AURA 2.0: From User-Driven Responses to Model-Initiated Conversations in Streaming Video
articles.content: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation. To move beyond purely user-driven interaction, we present AURA 2.0, a streaming video large language model that introduces three core upgrades to AURA. The key advance is Model-Initiated Conversation (MIC), which enables the model to identify topics worth discussing in the evolving visual stream and initiate conversations at appropriate moments without a user query. Stream-Aware Tool Calling (SATC) enables the model to invoke external tools using the current visual and conversational context and incorporate returned information into the ongoing interaction. Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG) supports visual grounding in both user inputs and model outputs. The model can identify objects marked by users on video frames and produce frame-aligned bounding boxes to link its responses to specific objects and regions. To develop these capabilities, we construct a dedicated streaming interaction dataset and adopt a three-stage training scheme to integrate the new behaviors with AURA's existing streaming interaction abilities. We further incorporate Long-Horizon Interaction Memory (LHIM) to maintain contextual continuity over extended video streams. Evaluations on public streaming benchmarks show that AURA 2.0 achieves leading performance among open-source streaming models, while targeted evaluations further validate its new interaction capabilities. We open-source the model weights and inference code.

articles.title_zh: AURA 2.0:从用户驱动的回复到流视频中模式启动的对话
articles.content_zh: 大多数AI助手只有在被催促时才会回应,即使在视频流中的事件为对话提供了有意义的机会时仍保持沉默. 为了超越纯粹用户驱动的互动,我们推出AURA 2.0,一个流传的视频大语言模型,引入了AURA的三个核心升级. 关键的进展是Model-Intirated Conversation(MIC),它使模型能够确定在不断发展的视觉流中值得讨论的议题,并在适当时刻启动对话,无需用户查询. Stream-Aware Tool Calling(SATC)使该模型能够利用目前的视觉和对话背景来引用外部工具,并将返回的信息纳入正在进行的互动。 互动视觉定位(IVG)支持在用户输入和模型输出中进行视觉定位. 该模型可以识别视频帧上用户标注的对象,并生成帧对齐的边框,将其响应与特定对象和区域链接起来. 为了发展这些能力,我们构建了一个专门的流线互动数据集,并采用一个三阶段的培训计划,将新行为与AURA现有的流线互动能力结合起来. 我们进一步将长视互动记忆(LHIM)纳入其中,以在扩展的视频流上保持背景连续性. 对公共流程基准的评价表明,AURA 2.0在开源流程模式中取得了领先业绩,而目标评价则进一步验证其新的互动能力。 我们打开模型重和推论代码的源头。

articles.title: ElasticDino: Dense Semantic Features Using Elastic Deformations
articles.content: Vision transformers (ViTs) serve as the backbone for countless vision tasks, including dense prediction tasks, such as segmentation and depth estimation, even though the quadratic complexity of self-attention severely limits feature resolution and induces spatial artifacts. In this work, we introduce ElasticDino, a lightweight adapter which produces high-resolution feature maps, adhering to the fine details of the input image. As a key insight, we observe the consistency of artifacts across channels, and simultaneously resolve them to match the input image structure. Using a slim architecture based on spatial deformations, ElasticDino produces pixel-aligned, high-resolution feature maps efficiently. Leveraging deformations allows strictly preserving sharp semantics, and thereby avoiding the smoothness biases inherent to alternative approaches. Due to the absence of ground truth, we employ pixel-level semantic segmentation and depth estimation with linear heads to predict a set of downstream dense tasks, guiding the deformation process without leaking task-specific semantics into the model. We demonstrate superior accuracy over current methods on a range of popular dense task benchmarks, with better computational performance.

articles.title_zh: 弹性Dino:使用弹性变形的定语功能
articles.content_zh: 视觉变压器(ViTs)是无数视觉任务的骨干,包括密密的预测任务,如分化和深度估计,尽管自觉的四极复杂严重限制了地物分辨率,诱导空间文物. 在这部作品中,我们引入了ElasticDino,一种轻量级适配器,它能产生高分辨率的特征图,坚持输入图像的细微细节. 作为关键洞察力,我们观察各种渠道的文物的一致性,同时解决它们,使其与输入图像结构相匹配. 利用基于空间变形的瘦小架构,ElasticDino高效地制作像素对齐的高分辨率特征图. 利用变形可以严格保留锐利的语义,从而避免替代方法固有的光滑偏差. 由于缺乏地面真实性,我们利用像素级语义分解和深度估计,用线性头来预测一系列下游密集的任务,引导变形过程而不向模型中泄露特定任务语义. 在一系列受欢迎的密集任务基准上,我们显示比目前方法更准确,而且计算性能更好。

articles.title: A Disease-specific Retinal Aging Biomarker for Predicting Progression to Late Age-related Macular Degeneration
articles.content: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss in older adults. While chronological age is a primary risk factor, it inadequately reflects individual variations in retinal aging, limiting effective AMD risk stratification and timely intervention. Here, we propose and validate fundus-based AMD age (FAA), which quantifies disease-specific retinal aging in AMD and captures accelerated AMD-related retinal aging, thereby improving prognostic precision over chronological age. Trained on 36,782 images from 2,192 participants in the Age-Related Eye Disease Study (AREDS) dataset and validated across AREDS and AREDS2 cohorts, our model demonstrates significant improvements over traditional chronological age-based approaches. Specifically, integrating the proposed FAA into Cox proportional-hazards models significantly enhances prediction performance. FAA improved the C-index from 0.836 to 0.888 and reduced the 5-year Brier score from 0.050 to 0.046 in AREDS, with consistent gains observed in AREDS2 (C-index 0.715 to 0.756; 2-year Brier 0.078 to 0.076). FAA showed improved prognostic performance across the two datasets and under different phenotype definitions (reading center-defined vs. specialist-defined grading), supporting its potential utility for AMD risk stratification. These findings highlight the advantage of incorporating FAA into AMD risk prediction frameworks, supporting further evaluation of FAA for AMD risk stratification.

articles.title_zh: 一种针对疾病的视网膜老化生物标记,用于预测晚年与年龄有关的肿瘤衰老
articles.content_zh: 与年龄有关的乳腺退化(AMD)是导致老年人视力丧失不可逆转的主要原因。 虽然年龄是主要风险因素,但它没有充分反映视网膜老化过程中的个别变化,限制了有效的AMD风险分层和及时干预。 在这里,我们提出并验证基于基金(FAA)的AMD年龄(FAA),它将AMD中特定疾病视网膜衰老量化,并捕捉加速AMD相关视网膜衰老,从而在时间跨度上提高预测精度. 在年龄相关眼病研究数据集的2 192名参与者的36 782幅图像上进行了培训,并在区域疾病相关眼病研究和区域疾病相关眼病研究2组中进行了验证。 具体地说,将拟议的FAA纳入Cox比例危险模型可大大提高预测性能. FAA将C指数从0.836改进为0.888,并将AREDS的5年布赖尔得分从0.050降至0.046,AREDS2(C-index 0.715降至0.756;2年布赖尔0.078降至0.076)观测到一致的增益. FAA显示,在两个数据集之间以及不同的苯型定义(读取中心定义与专家定义的分级)下,预测性能有所改善,支持其对AMD风险分级的潜在用途. 这些调查结果突出表明了将非洲金融分析法纳入AMD风险预测框架的优势,支持对AMD风险分层法的进一步评价。

articles.title: Report of the 8th LSVOS Challenge: Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding
articles.content: This report summarizes the Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026. MUMU asks for a single unified model that jointly performs multi-concept image tagging over quality, scene, and event vocabularies, open-vocabulary object detection, and concise image captioning, within a budget of 0.5B parameters and 8 GB of peak inference memory. Submissions are ranked by a weighted task score scaled by an efficiency factor. We describe the tasks, rules, and evaluation protocol, report the final results, and review the methods of the top three teams. All three leading solutions build on the compact Florence-2-base model, but extend it in different ways: lightweight tagging heads with cross-task inference refinement, a shared low-rank adapter trained on coverage-aware multi-source data with task-dependent decoding, and a training-free pipeline that maps captions to tags and applies detection test-time augmentation. The results show that a compact prompt-based vision-language model can serve all three outputs when supervision, decoding, and cross-task cues are designed for each task, while open-vocabulary detection on novel categories remains the main bottleneck.

articles.title_zh: 第八次LSVOS挑战报告:移动统一多式联运
articles.content_zh: 本报告概述了第8大视频对象分区移动统一多式联运轨道 挑战,与ECCV 2026同时举行. MUMU要求在0.5B参数和8GB峰值推论内存的预算范围内,建立一个单一的统一模型,在质量、场景和事件词汇上联合进行多概念图像标记,开放的vocabulary对象检测和简洁的图像字幕。 提交材料按效率系数加权任务分数排序。 我们描述各项任务、规则和评价规程,报告最终结果,并审查前三个小组的方法。 所有三种领先的解决方案都以紧凑的Florence-2-base模型为基础,但以不同的方式加以扩展:轻量级标记头与跨任务推论的改进,一个共享的低级适配器以任务依赖的解码对覆盖-知觉多源数据进行培训,以及一个无培训的管道,将标题映射到标记,并应用检测测试时间的增强. 结果显示,当为每项任务设计监督、解码和跨任务提示时,一个紧凑的即时视觉语言模型可以服务于所有三种产出,而新分类的开放式伏车检测仍然是主要的瓶颈。

articles.title: Automated PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Scoring with Uncertainty-Guided Triage in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
articles.content: Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) tumor proportion score (TPS) informs immunotherapy selection in non-small cell lung cancer. Near the 1% and 50% cutoffs, the score should also indicate when closer review is warranted. We designed a three-stage framework to follow the sequence of TPS assessment. Stage 1 identifies tumor regions and excludes macrophage-rich patches. Stage 2, a dual-branch cell counting network (D2Count-Net), counts PD-L1-positive and PD-L1-negative tumor cells in these regions to calculate TPS. Stage 3, TPS-Guard, an uncertainty-guided triage mechanism, reports model uncertainty as the disagreement among independently trained models, refers the most uncertain slides, and flags scores near the 1% or 50% cutoff when model estimates disagree across that cutoff. Flags state the reason for referral or alert the pathologist to possible scoring errors on auto-reported slides. In a retrospective, single-center study, 154 whole-slide images were scored by three pathologists, and the model and each pathologist were compared in turn with the mean of the other two. On the 114 slides unseen in training, model mean absolute error (MAE) was 6.96 percentage points, within the range of the three pathologists (4.24 to 8.29), and model uncertainty correlated with absolute TPS error (Spearman rho = 0.77) and inter-pathologist disagreement (rho = 0.71). After referral of the 15% most uncertain slides, model and pathologist MAE both decreased. Applied without retraining to an external, publicly available dataset, TPS-Guard still directed review to higher-error cases, and referring more uncertain cases raised sensitivity at the 50% cutoff. TPS-Guard provides reasons for reviewing individual automated scores and identifies slides that also produce greater disagreement among pathologists. Prospective reader studies should assess TPS-Guard's effect on TPS reporting.

articles.title_zh: 在非小细胞肺癌中用不确定指针测定的肿瘤比例
articles.content_zh: 已规划的死胶和1(PD-L1)肿瘤比例分数为非小细胞肺癌的免疫疗法选择提供信息。 接近1%和50%的分数时,分数还应表明何时有必要进行更仔细的审查。 我们设计了一个三阶段框架,以遵循卫生和植物检疫评估的顺序。 第1阶段确定肿瘤区域,不包括富含宏观phage的补丁. 第2阶段,一个双分支细胞计数网络(D2Count-Net),在这些地区计算PD-L1阳性和PD-L1-阴性肿瘤细胞以计算TPS. 第3阶段,TPS-Guard,一种不确定性引导的分解机制,报告模型不确定性作为独立训练的模型之间的分歧,指最不确定的幻灯片,当模型估计在截断中出现分歧时,标记分数接近1%或50%。 旗帜说明转介或提醒病理学家在自动报告的幻灯片上可能打分错误的原因。 在一次回顾性,单中心研究中,154幅全滑影像被三名病理学家打分,模型和每个病理学家依次与另外两位的平均值进行比较. 在培训中未见的114个幻灯片中,模型表示的绝对误差(MAE)在3个病理学家(4.24至8.29)范围内为6.96个百分点,模型不确定性与绝对TPS误差(Spearman rho = 0.77)和病理学家间分歧(rho = 0.71)相关. 在转诊15%最不确定的幻灯片后,模型和病理学家MAE都减少了。 TPS-Guard在没有再培训的情况下应用到外部公开的数据集中,仍然将审查引向更严重的案件,而转介更不确定的案件则提高了50%的断点的敏感性。 TPS-Guard提供了审查个人自动分数的理由,并确定了同样在病理学家之间产生较大分歧的幻灯片. 未来的读者研究应评估TPS-Guard对TPS报告的影响。

articles.title: TokenStream: Multi-Subject Personalized Video Generation with Token-wise LoRA and Guided Attention
articles.content: We introduce TokenStream, an optimization-based framework that composes independently learned subject identities in text-to-video generation without a reference-video training dataset or joint optimization of each new subject combination. Learning from a single reference image makes subject appearance difficult to separate from static-image bias, while merging independently trained adapters can mix identities. Token-wise LoRA (ToRA) restricts low-rank updates to the cross-attention value projections of subject-associated text tokens, providing a separate adaptation path for each subject. A T2V-guided stream copies queries and keys from the frozen base model during early denoising to reuse its layout and motion priors while retaining personalized values. We also introduce Multi-DB, a 30-subject, 122-prompt benchmark with appearance-free prompts and varied interactions. On Multi-DB at 1.3B, TokenStream improves identity preservation from 0.422 for DreamBooth to 0.467 and textual alignment from 0.652 to 0.688.

articles.title_zh: TokenStream:多子对象个性化视频生成,带有Token-wise LoRA和引导关注
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了TokenStream,这是一个基于优化的框架,它编集了文本到视频生成中独立学习的主题身份,没有参考视频培训数据集,也没有对每个新主题组合进行联合优化. 从单一的参考图像中学习,使主体外观难以与静态图像偏差区分开来,同时合并独立训练的适配器可以混合身份. Token-wise LoRA (TORA) 将低级更新限制在主题相关文本符号的交叉意向值预测,为每个主题提供了单独的适应路径. 一个T2V制导的流复制了冷冻基模型的查询和密钥,在早期去诺重新使用其布局和运动前缀同时保留个性化值. 我们还采用了多功能数据库,这是一个30个主体、122个即时基准,具有无外观提示和各种互动。 在1.3B的Multi-DB上,TokenStream将身份保护从DreamBooth的0.422改进为0.467,文本对齐从0.652改进为0.688.

articles.title: Raysemble: Metric 3D Bone Reconstruction from a Single X-ray
articles.content: Raysemble reconstructs eight lumbar and pelvic bones from a single X-ray by separating shape and placement. Each 3D query samples regional and global features at its image projection. A shared decoder predicts normalized bone shapes. Predicted depth and camera geometry determine 3D centers and scales for resampling these shapes onto a common grid in millimeters. Evaluation uses 23 held-out patients with 43 CT scans, each generating one simulated anteroposterior radiograph. Without rigid alignment to CT,Raysemble leads 15 evaluated methods, averaging 65.24% Dice, 9.09 mm HD95, and 3.32 mm ASSD over three random seeds. With identical inputs, it improves Dice over VolumeNeRF by 5.86 percentage points.

articles.content_zh: 雷森布尔通过将形状和布置分开,从单X射线上重建8根腰骨和盆骨. 每个3D查询在其图像投影时都对区域和全球特征进行抽样. 一个共享的解码器预测正常的骨骼形状. 预测的深度和相机几何决定了3D中枢和尺度,将这些形状以毫米的方式重印到共同的网格上. 评价使用23个持有43个CT扫描的停机病人,每个病人产生一个模拟的Anterposefore射电图. 不与CT僵硬对齐,雷瑟姆布勒领先15种评价方法,平均65.24%的Dice,9.09毫米HD95,以及3.32毫米ASSD超过3个随机种子. 由于投入相同,Dice比VolumeNERF提高了5.86个百分点.

articles.title: Visual Cipher Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Reasoning
articles.content: While language-model agents excel at long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, this success relies on two conditions: explicit text specifications and immediate execution feedback. However, neither condition holds in real-world problems where critical information exists only in images, leaving it unclear whether long-horizon capability transfers from text to visual reasoning. In such visual settings, because rules and clues resist text transcription and lack test-case feedback, agents must repeatedly inspect images, simulate spatial transformations, and autonomously cross-check clues. Despite this challenge, existing evaluations fail to capture such capability: visual reasoning benchmarks largely reduce tasks to single-turn, short-chain question answering, whereas agent benchmarks focus on text-based environments or interactive states that permit trial-and-error. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual Cipher Bench, a collection of 40 original visual puzzles across four categories: spatial manipulation and simulation, logical constraints and planning, rule induction, and knowledge-based decoding. Each puzzle provides only one to three black-and-white line drawings and a minimal submission instruction, requiring agents to discover the underlying solving mechanism entirely from the images. Across 29 reasoning-effort configurations of eight frontier models, even the strongest model, GPT-6 Astra (max), achieves only 26.7% accuracy, while five of the eight models score below 1%. Yet on a ten-task subset, providing a single non-spoiler mechanism hint boosts accuracy from 7.8% to 55.6%. This sharp contrast shows that the primary bottleneck of current agents lies not in executing multi-step plans, but in autonomously discovering rules from visual evidence. Visual Cipher Bench thus provides a rigorous benchmark for measuring long-horizon visual reasoning in agents.

articles.title_zh: Visual Cipher座椅:长视距视觉理性LLM代理基准
articles.content_zh: 虽然语言模型代理人在长视野编码和终端任务方面表现优异,但这一成功取决于两个条件:明确的文本规格和即时执行反馈. 然而,在只有图像中存在关键信息的现实世界问题中,这两个条件都不存在,因此,长期视距能力是否从文本转移到视觉推理方面尚不明确。 在这种视觉环境中,由于规则和线索抵制文本抄录,缺乏测试案例反馈,代理商必须反复检查图像,模拟空间变换,并自主检查线索. 尽管存在这一挑战,但现有的评价未能抓住这种能力:视觉推理基准在很大程度上将任务减少到单回合、短链问题回答,而代理基准则侧重于文本环境或允许审判和错误的互动状态。 为了弥合这一差距,我们引入了Visual Cipher Beaching, 这是一个包含40个原始视觉谜题的集合,它们跨越四个类别:空间操纵和模拟,逻辑约束和规划,规则诱导,以及基于知识的解码. 每个谜题仅提供一至三幅黑白线条图和最低限度的提交指令,要求代理完全从图像中发现基础解析机制. 8个前沿模型的29个推理-努力配置,甚至最强的模型GPT-6 Astra(最大),精确度仅达到26.7%,而8个模型中的5个得分低于1%. 然而,在一个十大任务子集中,提供单一的非破坏机制提示将精度从7.8%提高到55.6%。 这种尖锐的对比表明,当前代理人的主要瓶颈不在于执行多步骤计划,而在于自主地从视觉证据中发现规则. 视觉密码 因此,法官为衡量代理人的长视距视觉推理提供了严格的基准。

articles.title: Kosmo-GFM: A Production-Ready Geometry Foundation Model
articles.content: We present Kosmo-GFM, a scene reconstruction system that integrates a geometry foundation model (GFM), a pose optimization engine (PoseEngine), and reconstruction-derived supervision from KosmoWorld. GFM predicts camera parameters, depth, cross-view correspondences, and dynamic 3D points from images and videos. PoseEngine combines these predictions with geometric optimization to recover scene-level camera poses and geometry for downstream 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting. KosmoWorld generates images and geometric supervision from reconstructed real-world scenes to improve GFM's geometric predictions. On the Sparse and Medium subsets of SpatialBench, GFM achieves the lowest absolute relative depth error and the highest relative-pose AUC at 5 degrees among the compared methods. It also achieves the lowest mean endpoint errors for dynamic points and scene flow across the five evaluated datasets. Across 34 scenes completed by all compared reconstruction systems, PoseEngine achieves the highest scene-averaged pose AUC at thresholds of 1, 3, and 5 degrees, with a cumulative runtime of 14.07 hours, approximately 20% of GLUEMAP's 69.67 hours. PoseEngine Flash provides a further accuracy-efficiency trade-off, with a measured mixed-precision runtime of 2.62 hours, approximately 4% of GLUEMAP's runtime. Separate scaling experiments show generally favorable trends with increased data, model computation, and training budgets. These results support the use of learned geometric priors within a scene-level reconstruction pipeline.
